statements.statement: The service is CPT code 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry)
The patient has diagnosis codes I25.10 and I34.0
The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service is ordered to correlate intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias
The service is ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
